tools.name: get_pack

Add source_id to list that source's metrics (name, unit, years, aggregation) and its filterable and sortable fields; search to match metrics across the pack by name, description, or keyword; or metr

Optional year selects the latest admitted edition no later than that year when the selected catalog has an edition index; an unavailable index is reported

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "geography?registry=mcpregistry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_catalog · Public sink: resolve_deep_point.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_catalog · Public sink: resolve_deep_point

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "resolve_point" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
